description: FE-003-T02 performance budgets for the frontend production bundle. Enforced by frontend/scripts/checkPerformanceBudgets.js (npm run perf:budgets), wired into the "frontend" job of .github/workflows/ci.yml right after `npm run build`. See workflow/features/P2/FE-003-frontend-route-performance.md for the full rationale, including why most categories below start with baselineGzipKB: null instead of an invented target size.

main.description: Initial JS entry bundle -- the only JS loaded on first paint (CRA 5 uses webpack's default splitChunks: 'async', so every other chunk is on-demand). Includes the webpack runtime.
main.maxGzipKBNote: FE-003-T07 (2026-09-26): tightened from 378 KB (the pre-split audit figure) to 250 KB after the first real post-split CI build measured main at 194.54 KB. Everyday growth is enforced by baselineGzipKB + allowedGrowthPercent (~214 KB); this ceiling is an independent backstop that still holds if a baseline is later raised with --update-baseline --force, so main can never drift back toward its pre-split size unnoticed.

charts.description: TrendChartPage + BarChartPage + PieChartPage, lazy-loaded together from LandingPage.js (webpackChunkName: "charts") since FE-003-T06's prefetchCharts() already loads them as a group.

sia.description: SiaPanel (conversation UI + voice recording controls), lazy-loaded from SiaEntryPoint.js (webpackChunkName: "sia").

bill-upload.description: BillUpload (OCR bill-scanning flow), lazy-loaded from AddExpense.js (webpackChunkName: "bill-upload").

firebase-push.description: The Firebase SDK + pushNotification module, dynamically imported from useWebPush.js's registerToken() (webpackChunkName: "firebase-push") so it only loads when a token is actually requested.

other-chunks.description: Aggregate of any build output chunk that doesn't match a named category above (webpack's automatic vendor/runtime splits, or a future lazy import not yet given a webpackChunkName). Tracked in total so a new, unnamed chunk can't grow unbounded without ever being counted. With CRA 5's default async-only splitChunks these are the heavy vendor libraries (recharts/d3, Firebase SDK, etc.) split out of the named lazy chunks -- loaded on demand alongside them, never on first paint.

baselineSource: Baselines are the real gzip sizes from the first CI production build after FE-003-T02..T06 merged (commit 6e057f0, 'Performance budget check' step). See docs/frontend/FE-003-T07-before-after-bundle-measurements.md.
